snippet.title: Flock Off! Announcement Trailer - Wishlist Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Announcing Flock Off! An all-new first-person zombie-sheep action game 💥

🐑 Survive endless hordes of undead sheep 
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Up to 4 players team up for hilarious co-op carnage
🥖 Mow down enemies using unconventional weapons
🩸 Blood er– wool will be spilt 

Wishlist on Steam today: https://bit.ly/FlockOff 

#FlockOffGame #IndieGame #ZombieSheep #CoopGame #WishlistNow #SteamGame #CoopSurvival
